newsitem.title: POLAND: Two firms underwite Polish Unibud issue.
newsitem.headline: Two firms underwite Polish Unibud issue.

text.p: Polish construction firm Budimex and Kredyt Bank underwrote 700,000 out of a one-million-share initial public offering of the construction firm Unibud SA, the president of Unibud said on Thursday.
"Today we've signed underwriting deals with Kredyt Bank and Budimex, the underwriters are arranging a consortium underwriting 700,000 shares," Jan Mikoluszko said.
The issue will take place from January 20-31.
Mikoluszko said each of the underwriters agreed to take 350,000 shares and the stand-by fee was 0.75 percent. He said if they had to take the shares they would get an additional 1.65 percent.
He said he expected the bourse debut of the firm, which seeks a parallel market's listing, in late May or in early June at the latest.
The firm, which is 49.9 percent-owned by Budimex expects its net profit at 2.7 million zlotys this year. During 11 months of 1996 Unibud made a net profit of 1.9 million zlotys.
